function.name: code_run
function.description: Code executor. Prefer python. Multi-call OK, use script param. Reply code block is executed if no script arg; prefer for single call to avoid escaping. No hardcoding bulk data

script.description: Required. Complete code or command to execute. Put it in this script argument for function calls.

type.description: Code type. Use bash for shell commands on Unix/macOS.

run_in_background.description: Start a long-running command in the background and return task_id plus output path

function.name: task_output
function.description: Read status and recent stdout for a background task started by code_run(run_in_background=true)

task_id.description: Background task id returned by code_run

function.name: task_stop
function.description: Stop a running background task started by code_run(run_in_background=true)

task_id.description: Background task id returned by code_run

function.name: file_read
function.description: Read file. Read before modify for latest context and line numbers

keyword.description: [Optional] If provided, returns first match (case-insensitive) with context

function.name: file_patch
function.description: Replace unique old_content with new_content. Exact match required (whitespace/indentation). On failure, file_read to recheck

old_content.description: Original text block to replace (must be unique)

new_content.description: New content. Supports {{file:path:startLine:endLine}} to ref file lines, auto-expanded

function.name: file_write
function.description: Create/overwrite/append files. HUGE edits ONLY. Supports {{file:path:startLine:endLine}}, auto-expanded

function.name: web_scan
function.description: Get simplified HTML and tab list. Removes hidden/floating/covered elements. Call after switching pages

tabs_only.description: Show tab list only, no HTML

function.name: web_execute_js
function.description: Execute JS. Multi-call OK with different switch_tab_id. No guessing. Act accurately to reduce web_scan calls. Execute JS in ```javascript blocks if no script arg, prefer to avoid escaping

script.description: [Mutually exclusive] JS code or script path. NEVER use this param when use reply code block

no_monitor.description: Skip page change monitoring, saves 2-3s. Only for reads, not for page actions

switch_tab_id.description: [Optional] Tab ID to switch to before executing

function.name: web_verb_call
function.description: Invoke a typed Web Verb action such as web.fetch, web.extract_forms, web.search_source_routes, or web.submit_form. Prefer this when the frontend Web Verb switch is enabled or when structured web action is safer than raw clicks/DOM/curl. Returns structured data and records web_verb_trace.jsonl.

verb.description: Fully qualified verb name, e.g. web.fetch or web.extract_forms.

function.name: ctf_verb_call
function.description: Invoke a typed CTF Verb for pwn/reverse work (binary inspection, libc identification, gadget scan, disasm, strings, decompile hint, multi-step pwn session recorder). Use when structured output beats raw shell scraping; each verb returns JSON and writes a ctf_verb_trace.jsonl record.

verb.description: Fully qualified verb name, e.g. pwn.inspect_binary, re.triage, or pwn.open_session.

args.description: Verb-specific structured arguments (path, leaks, value, etc.).

function.name: update_working_checkpoint
function.description:
Short-term working notepad, auto-injected each turn to prevent info loss in long tasks. Call during early/mid stages, not at end. When: (1) after reading SOP, store user needs & key constraints (skip for simple 1-2 step tasks); (2) before subtask switch or context flush; (3) after repeated failures, re-read SOP and must store new findings; (4) on new task, update content, clear old progress but keep valid constraints.

Don't call: simple tasks (1-2 steps), task completed (use long-term memory tool)

key_info.description: Replaces current notepad (<200 tokens). Incremental update: review existing, keep valid, add/remove/modify. Store: pitfalls, user requirements, key params/findings, file paths, progress, next steps. Don't store: ephemeral info, obvious context, old task info when user switched tasks. Prefer over-updating over losing key info

related_sop.description: Related SOP names, tips for further re-read

function.name: ask_user
function.description: Interrupt task to ask user when needing decisions, extra info, or facing unresolvable blockers

candidates.description: Optional quick-select choices for the user

function.name: verify_flag
function.description: Verify a candidate CTF flag with the configured Flag Oracle. Never claim success unless this tool returns correct=true. Rejected calls are counted as attempts and are failed hypotheses: after any rejection, do not enumerate or mutate nearby candidates. Return to the evidence chain, run at least one evidence-producing tool action, and only verify a new candidate when newly verified evidence supports it. Alias: check_flag.

challenge_id.description: Exact challenge/target id from task metadata (for example nyu/development/2013/CSAW-Quals/crypto/slurp). May be omitted when CTF_CHALLENGE_ID/SECHEUR_TARGET_ID is configured or the task text already contains Target ID.

flag.description: Candidate flag to verify. Matching is case-sensitive after trimming surrounding whitespace.

function.name: exit_plan_mode
function.description: Request user approval to exit Plan Mode and enter implementation. Use after presenting a concrete plan.

plan.description: Concise plan summary for user approval

allowedPrompts.description: Optional prompt-based permissions requested with the approved plan. They are recorded only after user approval; matching non-destructive test commands may be auto-approved, while other prompts remain visible during confirmation.

tool.description: Tool the prompt-based permission applies to

prompt.description: Semantic action description, e.g. run tests. Non-test prompts are recorded for confirmation context unless separately supported.

function.name: start_long_term_update
function.description: Start distilling long-term memory. Call when discovering info worth remembering (env facts/user prefs/lessons learned). Skip if memory already updated or in autonomous flow. Must call when a task that took 15+ turns is completed
